Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but I'll say it. It's the same name on my policy.
Q: Understood. Where were you when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot in Conroe, Texas, near one of the big retail stores. I had just pulled into a row to find a spot.
Q: What were you doing right before impact?
A: I was backing out of a space slowly, maybe a few miles an hour. I had checked my mirror and it looked clear.
Q: Describe the other vehicle.
A: It was a pickup, silver I think, coming down the lane behind the row. It came around the end of the aisle faster than
I expected and clipped the rear corner of my car.
Q: Did you see the pickup before the contact?
A: Only for a second, right before. I braked, but there wasn't time to do much else.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: Not right away. I was stiff in the neck and my lower back started hurting that evening. I saw a doctor the next day
and was diagnosed with a neck and back strain.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I'm doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain relievers as needed.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add or correct?
A: No, that's everything I can remember. I'll send the medical notes when I get them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
